templates.why_chosen: A star exemplar that annotates each mechanism with its paper section number (section 5, 6.1, 6.3) on the diagram itself, with Frontend as hub fanning into GPU group 0 ... GPU group n spokes.
templates.what_to_learn: Tie each drawn mechanism to its paper section number right on the box, so the figure doubles as a reading index; but name what the ellipsis between group 0 and group n hides, since leaving it uncounted is this exemplar's own recorded weakness.
